notes.title: From Poland With Love ❤️
notes.content:
Hello Players!

Our game is a part of an unique Steam Sale that offers the best gaming experiences filled with action, mystery, and fun brought to you straight from Poland - From Poland With Love ❤️, running August 12-19!

This is a wonderful occasion to dive into some incredible indie games and discover the creativity that Polish people bring to the gaming world!

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch with Korean language is here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Cosmic Players,[/b]

We are coming back to you with the new update. It brings one major change to our [b]Korean Symmetrians[/b] - full subtitles in the native language of this beautiful peninsula. It doesn't end there though, as we managed to implement other [b]improvements for everyone[/b]:

[list][*]Notification when one of the characters has a low life level,
[*]Information about the main goal for the player at the end of the intro,
[*]New names of the difficulty levels.[/list]

Let us know in the comment section what you think about the changes and be brave on your next deadly mission ;)

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/34df512a19ca911afa604afd8cbd34131a7b734f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch for ultrawide monitors is here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello fellow Symmetrians,[/b]

Following one of the most often requests from our amazing community, we decided to prepare official support for the [b]ultrawide monitors[/b]. From now on, you can enjoy playing [b]SYMMETRY[/b] in all glorious [b]21:9[/b] resolutions. The UI was adjusted to your screens and should no longer be an issue, but please let us know if the game displays properly now on your hardware.

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team[/i]

notes.title: SYMMETRY is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/fd37baf7c25ae1bb79fc7629c7f62e430e92c5df.png[/img]
[b]Hello fellow Symmetrians,[/b]

The long-awaited day for our community just came! [b]SYMMETRY[/b] - a survival management game set in a retro-futuristic, sci-fi universe is now available on [b]Steam (PC and MAC)[/b] for $11.99USD/9.99 EUR/8.99GBP and on [b]PlayStation®4[/b] for $17.99 USD/14.99 EUR/12.99 GBP. It will be released on [b]Xbox One[/b] on February 23, 2018, for $17.99 USD/14.99 EUR/12.99 GBP.

You thought this is it? No way! To mark this awesome occasion, we prepared a launch trailer, which you can watch below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IsbpvJ9_vVU&feature=youtu.be
We hope you will have a great time helping to rescue your crew. Remember to implement various strategies and experiment with different members at the start to beat the game. Don't be selfish with it and share your tactics with other Symmetrians on our discussion boards. They're dying out there!

Good luck! You're going to need it ːsteammockingː

[b]Take care![/b]
[i]Jan, IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team[/i]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/e5a6f9470d92dac70c4708eac0e610f43b2102cf.png[/img]
Hello fellow Symmetrians,

We are proud to announce that [b]SYMMETRY[/b] is launching on [b]Steam (PC & Mac), PlayStation®4 and Xbox One on February 20, 2018![/b] The waiting time seemed to be long, but we used it wisely to provide the best experience possible. 

Without spoiling the fun, [b]Dariusz Leczycki[/b], co-owner of our studio has a special message to all the players:

[i]“As a survival management game, SYMMETRY’s storyline will propel you forward toward big payoffs depending upon the strategies employed across the survivors,”[/i]
[i]“At first look, SYMMETRY is basic, old school looking game, but don’t be fooled, it is complex, compelling, and most of all, fun, and possesses a storyline that you don’t see coming.”[/i]

Also, to mark this fantastic occasion, we prepared a new trailer. Enjoy watching it and leave us some feedback in the comments section:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWV22Vbi4eg&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Symmetry is a 'survival management' game about a crashed spaceship and an alien horror
notes.content:
The trouble with deep space exploration is that it's awfully easy for the people doing it to die. That, simplistically, is the situation in the retro-future sci-fi survival management sim Symmetry, which publisher IMGN Pro announced today will be released on February 20: Your research vessel has crash-landed on a desolate planet, and now you have to get as much of the crew as you can back home. 

Crew members will have to maintain both their physical and their mental health as they take on tasks that may be far outside their conventional expertise. Moral choices will have to be made—the Steam page references "collectivism vs individualism"—and toughing it out isn't an option, because the clock is ticking. And it's not just the extreme weather on the planet that's out to kill your team: "Life-threatening supernatural activities" will become increasingly common as time passes. 

"As a survival management game, Symmetry's storyline will propel you forward toward big payoffs depending upon the strategies employed across the survivors," Dariusz Leczycki of developer Sleepless Clinic said. "At first look, Symmetry is a basic, old school looking game, but don’t be fooled, it is complex, compelling, and most of all, fun, and possesses a story line that you don’t see coming." 

Visually, Symmetry strikes me as a cross between The Long Dark and The Final Station, which is not a bad place to start, but what really hooks me is the promise of a "non-obvious sci-fi plot." Survivors of a crashed spaceship struggling against time to escape the clutches of an otherworldly terror sounds like something Andre Norton would've written in 1953, and that's the kind of game I want to know more about.
